gloss: to become proficient; to master; to become skilled

definitions.gloss: to become proficient; to master; to become skilled at
definitions.explanation: To gain thorough knowledge and skill in something through practice and study. Implies reaching a high level of competence through sustained effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{習熟|しゅうじゅく}する。
examples.english: To become proficient at operating it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{習熟|しゅうじゅく}する⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time to become skilled at this job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{習熟|しゅうじゅく}する⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{全社員|ぜんしゃいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧とした⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Training was conducted for all employees to become proficient with the new system.

notes:
A formal word often used in workplace, education, and technical training contexts. Takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the skill or subject being mastered. The noun form ⟦{習熟|しゅうじゅく}→習熟：21086_shuujuku⟧ is used in compounds like ⟦{習熟|しゅうじゅく}→習熟：21086_shuujuku⟧⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (proficiency level).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{習熟|しゅうじゅく}→習熟：21086_shuujuku⟧⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧: proficiency level, degree of mastery
- ⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{習熟|しゅうじゅく}する: to master the operation
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{習熟|しゅうじゅく}する: to become skilled at one's duties
- {習熟|しゅうじゅく}した⟦{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}→技術者：17049_gijutsusha⟧: a skilled technician

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{熟練|じゅくれん}→熟練：09081_jukuren⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become experienced — emphasizes long practical experience
- ⟦{上達|じょうたつ}する→上達する：17981_joutatsusuru⟧: to improve — focuses on the process of getting better, not the endpoint
- ⟦{精通|せいつう}→精通：15453_seitsuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be well-versed in — focuses on deep knowledge rather than hands-on skill
